page.layout: Running head at top, with page number at top left. Main block: one boxed list of consuls, with the years printed in the right margin beside it. Left margin: one italic marginal note beside the list. Below the box: three centred lines (FASTORUM COSS. / GRONING. / FINIS.). Nothing else is printed.
page.notes: The years 1642, 1643 and 1644 stand in the right margin beside the list, each beside a group of consuls; they are placed here by their nearest line. The left-margin note "Mors Henrici Alting Theolog." is in italic and is set beside the line "Wolter Schonenborch." of the 1644 group. The list is enclosed in a rule box. The printed letter forms of the years and of the names (Iulsinge, Eisinge, Hooftman, Schonenborch, Heeck) are copied as printed. The line "FASTORUM COSS. GRONING." and "FINIS." are closing lines in capitals, written as paragraphs.
